data.desc: Quanome Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: QNME) is a U.S.-based company headquartered in New York, New York. Quanome is building capabilities and an investment portfolio at the intersection of quantum technologies, artificial intelligence, advanced simulation and intelligent systems. Through internal development, strategic relationships and selected investments, Quanome seeks to translate emerging science into real-world applications across life sciences, cybersecurity, advanced materials, energy, financial systems and other industries shaped by complex computational challenges.
